The returned Transition is built from that exact successful result with the actual after-world and tuple, pinned installed-code facts and actual context equality. There is no independent synthetic transition substituted for the success witness.

guarantees uses the same Transition in SystemJournal.preserves and JournalGuarantees.completed. Initial invariant, budget<2^128 and calldata-size fit derive the local domains; the final invariant and all three Observed predicates use identical call/result fields.

empty_guarantees specializes to ByteArray.empty and kernel-discharges its width bound. This covers a pinned empty-call shape, not an assertion that a proposed drain migration is the default protocol schedule.
assumptions_and_limits: The initial invariant/installed canonical image, supplied header/history/gasPrice context, calldata fit and Nat-fuel lower bound remain inputs; no protocol initialization producer is provided here.
The 30M value is a pinned-evaluator counterpart. Amsterdam dual execution/state-gas pools, gas-price/base-fee conversion, original-world/substate mapping and reference call equivalence remain open.

Canonical SYSTEM admission/scheduling, inhibition/upgrades/migration policy and reference SYSTEM liveness are not proved. Successful pinned execution at 30M cannot alone establish reference resource sufficiency.
All three local observations are conditional on the explicit initial invariant and budget; the module does not claim global protocol closure or ancestor-log survival.
